name: mondrift-chase
description: Silent-drift reproducer: debug Samurai creates a jackal adjacent, wizard-teleports 10 east, then rests 40 turns while the jackal chases across the level; every recorded screen pins the jackal's exact per-turn path so the port's first divergent monster step is localized.
